May 16, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Steinberg Global Asset Management decreased its stake in Graham Hldgs Co (GHC) by 31.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Steinberg Global Asset Management sold 824 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.83% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1,792 shares of the other consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.00 million, down from 2,616 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Steinberg Global Asset Management who had been investing in Graham Hldgs Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.26 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.14% or $0.83 during the last trading session, reaching $607.58. About 6,199 shares traded. Graham Holdings Company (NYSE:GHC) has risen 1.87% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.68% the S&P500.
Partnervest Advisory Services Llc increased its stake in Main Street Capital Corp (MAIN) by 115.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Partnervest Advisory Services Llc who had been investing in Main Street Capital Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.29 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.18% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $38.43. About 132,358 shares traded. Main Street Capital Corporation (NYSE:MAIN) has risen 0.58% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.97% the S&P500.
Steinberg Global Asset Management, which manages about $604.10 million and $695.45M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Cisco Sys Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO) by 8,298 shares to 34,694 shares, valued at $1.33 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB) by 2,830 shares in the quarter, for a total of 17,381 shares, and has risen its stake in At&T Inc (NYSE:T).
